title: Puthoff says he consulted on the net assessment, with Hadley involved

tellings.quote: also Hal Putoff is on record saying he consulted for this net assessment. National security adviser Steven Hadley was involved

plain: A physicist named Harold Puthoff is on record, according to Michels, as saying he consulted on a government "net assessment", a high-level study that weighs a strategic question, apparently on unexplained craft, in the 2000s. Michels adds that Stephen Hadley, then the US national security adviser, was involved. Michels says this himself, without naming the record, in an episode with a former Senate staffer named Kirk McConnell, and it would mean the subject reached the top of the White House security staff.
